                           PETITION FOR REVIEW

      Pursuant to Section 313 of the Federal Power Act, 16 U.S.C. § 8251(b), and

Rule 15(a) of the Federal Rules of Appellate Procedure ("FRAM"), the PJM

Industrial Customer Coalition ("PJMECC"), the Industrial Energy Consumers of

America ("IECA"), and the National Railroad Passenger Corporation ("Amtrak")

(collectively, "Petitioners"), hereby petition this Court for judicial review of the

following orders issued by Respondent, Federal Energy Regulatory Commission

("Commission"):

      1. PJM Interconnection, L.L.C., Order on Show Cause Proceeding, Directing
         Compliance Filings, Establishing Paper Hearing, and Granting in Part and
         Denying in Part Complaint, Docket Nos. EL25-49-000, -001, AD24-11-
         000, EL25-20-000, 193 FERC ¶ 61,217 (Dec. 18, 2025) ("December 18
         Order"); and

      2. PJM Interconnection, L.L.C., Notice of Denial of Rehearing by Operation
         of Law and Providing for Further Consideration, Docket Nos. EL25-49-
         002, AD24-11-001, EL25-20-001, 194 FERC ¶ 62,089 (Feb. 20, 2026)
         ("Denial Notice").
       The Court should note that on January 20, 2026, Petitioners PJMICC and

IECA timely filed a Request for Clarification or, in the Alternative, Rehearing, of

the December 18 Order.' On February 20, 2026, the Commission issued the Denial

Notice providing for further consideration, signaling that the Commission will issue

a substantive order on rehearing at some point in the future. However, as provided

for in the Denial Notice, because the Commission did not "act[ ] upon the application

for rehearing within thirty days after it is filed, such application may be deemed to

have been denied." 16 U.S.C. § 8251(a). This Petition for Review is timely filed

"within sixty days after the order [i.e., the Denial Notice] of the Commission upon

the application for rehearing." 16 U.S.C. § 8251(b).

      Venue is appropriate in this Circuit because the public utility to which the

order relates, PJM Interconnection, L.L.C., maintains its principal place of business

in Audubon, Pennsylvania. See 16 U.S.C. § 8251(b).

                                               Respectfully submitted,

                                               By: /s/ Kenneth R. Stark
                                               Kenneth R. Stark
                                               Brigid Landy Khuri
                                               McNees Wallace & Nurick LLC
                                               100 Pine Street

1 Norwood v. FERC, 906 F.2d 772, 775 (D.C. Cir. 1990) (requiring an aggrieved
party to file a request for rehearing at FERC prior to a petition for review in appellate
court). Amtrak filed a motion to intervene in the underlying FERC proceeding on
March 20, 2026, after becoming aware of the impacts of the December 18 Order on
Amtrak. Amtrak agreed to accept the record as it stood, and Amtrak's interests in
this case are aligned with the issues raised in the PJMICC/TECA rehearing request.
